vendors.name: Aembit Workload IAM
vendors.offering: Workload IAM: secretless, policy-based access using native cloud identities across clouds
vendors.pricing: free Starter tier (10 workloads or 3 AI agents); Teams starts at $20/workload/month (workloads) and $20/agent/month (agentic AI), per Aembit's FAQ; Enterprise priced by scale

vendors.name: Teleport Machine & Workload Identity
vendors.offering: Short-lived certificates and workload identity for machines, CI/CD and services
vendors.pricing: not public (MWI bundled in Enterprise Standard; each tbot instance billed as a Teleport Protected Resource, hourly-averaged; no separate per-MWI price)

vendors.name: Defakto (formerly SPIRL)
vendors.offering: SPIFFE-based non-human identity platform issuing short-lived workload identities

vendors.name: HCP Vault Dedicated (HashiCorp/IBM)
vendors.offering: Secrets manager with dynamic short-lived AWS credentials via AWS secrets engine
vendors.pricing: hourly cluster fee plus ~$112.17/client/month (Standard and Plus tiers, official HashiCorp price list)

vendors.name: Akeyless
vendors.offering: SaaS secrets and machine identity with workload identity federation across clouds
vendors.pricing: free 5 clients; paid tiers not public

vendors.name: Infisical
vendors.offering: Open-core secrets and machine identity with AWS IAM role-based auth
vendors.pricing: free tier; Pro $20/identity/month billed annually ($23 monthly); Advanced $40 annually

vendors.name: Oasis NHI Security Cloud (now Cyera Identity)
vendors.offering: Non-human identity discovery, posture and lifecycle management; Oasis acquired by Cyera (~$1B, 2026) and operates as Cyera Identity
vendors.pricing: AWS Marketplace 'Cyera Identity (Oasis) Starter Pack' $100,000/12 months (legacy Oasis-branded listing showed $50,000/12 months)

vendors.name: CyberArk (Palo Alto Networks)
vendors.offering: Machine identity, secrets management and PAM, now part of Palo Alto platform

paid_market_gaps.gap: Per-identity/per-client pricing scales with machine count, punishing workload-heavy teams (Infisical Pro $20-23/identity, HCP Vault ~$112/client, Aembit $20/workload).
Paid secrets tools lag new AWS mechanisms: Vault lacked IAM Roles Anywhere; External Secrets broke on EKS Pod Identity.

Workload identity is mostly sold as quote-only or large enterprise bundles (Teleport TPR-metered Enterprise, Defakto, Cyera Identity $100k/12-month starter); Aembit Teams at $20/workload is the main self-serve exception.
Consolidation (CyberArk to Palo Alto, Astrix to Cisco) leaves buyers wary of standalone NHI vendor roadmaps.

wtp_evidence: Established paid products with public prices: HCP Vault Dedicated ~$112.17/client/month (Standard, official price list), Aembit Teams from $20/workload/month (Aembit FAQ), Cyera Identity (Oasis) Starter Pack $100,000/12 months on AWS Marketplace.
bundling_note: AWS gives IRSA, EKS Pod Identity and IAM Roles Anywhere (no service charge) plus SDK default-chain support for free, covering the core in-AWS and off-AWS need.
summary: AWS-only role credentials are free and native; paid money sits in multi-cloud workload identity/NHI platforms, already crowded and consolidating (Cyera-Oasis, Palo Alto-CyberArk). A narrow opening: cheap self-serve cross-cloud workload identity for mid-market teams, priced against per-identity Vault/Infisical bills and Aembit's $20/workload Teams tier.
